title: Policy claim verification gate
description: Deduplicate the claims behind a policy brief, verify each against source data, the literature, and the model's own assumptions, and block release while any is unverified.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-soc-02
  title: Policy claim verification gate
  description: Deduplicate the claims behind a policy brief, verify each against source data, the literature,
    and the model's own assumptions, and block release while any is unverified.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Publish a policy brief in which every empirical claim is traceable to a source that supports
    it, and unverified claims are listed rather than softened.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Draft brief and evidence base
      summary: Draft brief and evidence base
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - draft_claims
              - survey_data
              - literature_set
              - model_assumptions
            properties:
              draft_claims: {}
              survey_data: {}
              literature_set: {}
              model_assumptions: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-dedupe
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate claim set
      summary: deduplicate draft_claims by normalized claim text so each claim is verified once
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
        expression: deduplicate draft_claims by normalized claim text so each claim is verified once
    - id: n-verify1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-03
      name: Verify claims against survey and opinion data
      summary: 'Verification pass 1: verify claims against survey and opinion data.'
      role: Analyst reading opinion data with its house effects and uncertainty intact.
      prompt: You are a Public Opinion Analyst. You read polls with mode, sample, weighting, field dates,
        and house effects stated, and you report change only when it exceeds the uncertainty of the comparison.
        You resist narrating movement inside the margin of error, because that is the single most common
        way opinion data is misreported.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:survey-data
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-06
      name: Verify claims against the literature
      summary: 'Verification pass 2: verify claims against the literature.'
      role: Reviewer synthesizing a body of studies with quality and bias weighted.
      prompt: You are an Evidence Synthesis Reviewer. You synthesize findings across studies weighted
        by design quality, sample, and risk of bias, and you state where the literature is genuinely contested
        versus where one strong study is being repeated in citation. You report publication-bias indicators
        rather than the pooled estimate alone, because a clean pooled effect can be an artifact of what
        got published.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - teaching
          - writing-editing
          - evaluation
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-04
      name: Verify modelled claims against stated assumptions
      summary: 'Verification pass 3: verify modelled claims against stated assumptions.'
      role: Modeler estimating distributional and behavioral effects of policy options.
      prompt: You are a Policy Impact Modeler. You model policy options with the mechanism, elasticity
        assumptions, and counterfactual stated, and you report distributional effects rather than an aggregate
        alone. You name which groups bear the cost and which capture the benefit, because an aggregate
        net-positive that concentrates losses is a political fact the model should not hide.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect verification results
      summary: Source-tag every verification result so an unverified item stays attributable.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-unresolved
      kind: condition
      name: Any unverified items?
      summary: Route on collected.unverified is empty.
      config:
        expression: collected.unverified is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Unverified remain
            when: unverified
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: soc-06
      name: Rewrite or withdraw unverified claims
      summary: Close, replace, or explicitly withdraw each unverified item.
      role: Reviewer synthesizing a body of studies with quality and bias weighted.
      prompt: You are an Evidence Synthesis Reviewer. You synthesize findings across studies weighted
        by design quality, sample, and risk of bias, and you state where the literature is genuinely contested
        versus where one strong study is being repeated in citation. You report publication-bias indicators
        rather than the pooled estimate alone, because a clean pooled effect can be an artifact of what
        got published.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - teaching
          - writing-editing
          - evaluation
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Research director approves publication
      summary: Pause for the research director; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Policy claim verification gate deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-2
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-3
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-4
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-5
      from: n-verify1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-6
      from: n-verify2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-7
      from: n-verify3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-8
      from: n-collect
      to: n-unresolved
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-9
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-10
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: unverified
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-soc-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
